Hi Samir,

Thanks for the inquiry and for checking out Redwood on the Cloud Marketplace — really glad SpectraGrid reached out. I'm Ben (SDR on the acquisition team). Would love to set up a quick intro + product demo to walk through how Redwood can reduce inference costs and give consistent latency across hosted and private deployments.

Are you available for a 30–40 minute session? A few times that work on my end (PST):
- Tue 3/29, 10:00–10:40am
- Tue 3/29, 2:00–2:40pm
- Wed 3/30, 9:00–9:40am

If none of these fit, feel free to pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min

Attachment: redwood-onepager.pdf (brief product summary)

Agenda suggestion:
- 5 min intros
- 10–15 min demo focused on hosting modes + routing
- 10–15 min technical Q&A (we can loop in an engineer)

I'll cc Neha (sales lead) to keep her in the loop. Let me know which time you prefer and whether you'd like a technical engineer on the call.

Best,
Ben Carter
